meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw:先探测已有服务器,没有就经同意建本地测试服务器;再设置 SiteURL、建机器人并配置回调,最终开通私信、频道、文件、回应和审批卡片。消息走 WebSocket,卡片点击走 HTTP 回调。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Mattermost 机器人频道,或要求打通 Mattermost 与 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.text: 把 Mattermost 机器人频道接入 NanoClaw。
say.note: Claude 会先寻找可用服务器再继续。

say.text: 没有本地 Mattermost,帮我搭个评估服务器。
say.note: Claude 会先说明创建内容并等待批准。

howto.what_en: Mattermost gets a NanoClaw channel: Claude finds a server or (with consent) installs one, then sets SiteURL, adds adapter code, creates a bot/callback, resolves owner DM. DMs, channels, files, reactions, approval cards work via WebSocket and HTTP.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add a Mattermost bot channel, or to connect Mattermost to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost bot channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude probes for an existing server before continuing.

say_en.text: Connect my Mattermost server at https://mm.example.com.
say_en.note: NanoClaw validates the URL and uses it as base.

say_en.text: Set up a local Mattermost evaluation server.
say_en.note: Claude explains what will be created and asks for approval.
